name: sprint20_taker_imbalance_reversion_majors
hypothesis: Short-horizon taker buy/sell volume imbalance on liquid majors (BTCUSD, ETHUSD) predicts mean reversion over the next 10-15 minutes, where sprint19 likely failed to populate due to altcoin order-flow sparsity rather than a true null.
power_argument: Majors have continuous taker-flow ticks; targeting >=300 qualifying entries requires imbalance_threshold set to roughly top-decile extremes over the test window (est. 1-3/day/symbol x 2 symbols x ~60-90 days sealed-window budget). Min detectable edge at n=300, sigma~40bps typical crypto 15m vol: ~9-10bps net, i.e. must clear >2x current fee-tier cost to be actionable.
